definitions.yipit:
We calculate run-rate revenue differently depending on channel. API revenue is based on the T28D period multiplied by 13 (weeks in year), while the latest daily consumer subscription figure is converted to monthly run-rate and then annualized x 12. Our B2B panel is annualized by dividing the spend by days in a month, multiplied by 365.

We calculate December API run-rate figures using the 20th of each month, instead of the last day of the month, to account for holiday seasonality.
definitions.company: “Run-Rate Revenue” is an operating metric that refers to the estimated annualized value of our revenue-generating activity as of a measurement date, calculated as the sum of (i) our consumption-based fees during the trailing 28-day period ended on the measurement date, multiplied by 13, and (ii) our aggregate monthly subscription fees as of the measurement date, multiplied by 12. For purposes of calculating Run-Rate Revenue, consumption-based fees and subscription-based fees are derived from customer usage and active subscriptions.
